body:
DUELS tab shows PLAY for an accepted duel with a live match_token; clicking it queues with that token via the existing QUEUE wire path. DwDuel gained match_token field, parsed via dw_json_str. Live-verified end to end: real dw_gui under Xvfb, driven by real xdotool clicks (Main Menu -> FRIENDS & DUELS -> DUELS tab -> PLAY), paired specifically with a real dw_client CLI partner on the same token against a real dw_server -- not FIFO. scripts/build.sh --gui clean. Commit 9afdda5. Web client and WOTAN still need Phase 3 wiring.

⚓ ☃
title: Duel Phase 3a: native SDL2 client PLAY button queues with match_token (S537)
